info.name: Volt Streaming API
info.description: Control-plane API for Volt Streaming. Bearer-auth (JWT) unless noted; the encoder ingest route uses X-Volt-Ingest-Token. Each request ships with a **saved example response** captured from a live run — open the request and pick the example to see the exact output. Set baseUrl/token/ids in the environment, or run api/verify.sh which seeds them.

item.name: Image Service
item.description: On-the-fly image resize/crop/format/filter on sharp. Two surfaces: POST /api/images/sign (JWT, control plane) returns a signed URL; the render endpoint (signed URL grammar, public) returns image bytes from {{imgBase}}. STATUS (12 Aug 2026): prototype, not yet mounted in the control plane at :8080, so these are not part of api/verify.sh yet. Set imgBase/imgPath/imgSig in the environment.

exec: // canonicalPath starts with the transform; the sig is the first path seg of j.url after imgBase

request.description: Turn transform options (path, fit, width/height, filters, expiresIn) into a signed render URL. Backend/app callers use this so they never compute the HMAC themselves. Auth: JWT. NOTE: Image Service is a prototype not yet mounted in the control plane at :8080; mounting src/modules/images.ts makes this answer locally.

response.name: 200 example

request.description: Fetch (or serve from cache) the derivative via a signed URL. Grammar: {imgBase}/{sig}/{fit}/{WxH}/filter(...)/{path}. Set imgSig from the Sign image URL response. Auth: signed URL (HMAC), public. Prototype: served by the image service host ({{imgBase}}), not the control plane.

response.name: 200 example (headers)
response.body: <binary image bytes: the rendered WebP>. This request returns image data, not JSON. See the response Headers tab for Content-Type, Cache-Control (immutable), ETag, X-Volt-Cache (HIT|MISS) and X-Volt-Render-ms. A repeat request returns X-Volt-Cache: HIT with X-Volt-Render-ms ~1.

request.description: Same render endpoint with signing disabled (only when the service runs with IMG_ALLOW_UNSAFE=1). Handy for local testing without signing. fill + focus:smart crops to 640x360 anchored by libvips attention.
